_about: unlisted: the run keeps its page (and its old links), but is left off the menu, the run cards and the overview chart, and named in a footnote on the introduction instead.

series.name: The seed series
series.blurb: The caretaker inherited a small world that already existed.

series.name: The genesis series
series.blurb: The caretaker started with one empty room and was told to make a world.

runs.title: Run 000: The Pilot
runs.tagline: A two-turn pilot, run in a world people had already been playing by hand.

runs.title: Run 001: The Keyhole
runs.tagline: It described a locked door with no working lock. A player prayed about it, and it apologized and built one.
facts: about two and a half hours

runs.title: Run 002: The Wrong World
runs.tagline: Voided. It woke up in the previous run's world by mistake, noticed, and wouldn't deploy over it.

runs.title: Run 003: The Sunken Stair
runs.tagline: The first run that could edit the engine, and it started on its first turn. When players asked for more, it added a sunken stair and a wall that takes four players to open.

runs.title: Run 004: The Troll's Whistle
runs.tagline: It never added a room. Instead it made the six it had remember the players who died in them.

runs.title: Genesis v1: Ambroke
runs.tagline: A village under a wall of standing sea. It built the whole thing in its first turn and spent the rest of the run fixing it.

runs.title: Genesis, Sonnet: The Rise
runs.tagline: It built eight rooms in its first turn and stopped. It added a ninth only after a player kept asking why the world was so small.

runs.title: Genesis v2: The Lighthouse Coast
runs.tagline: A lighthouse coast, built in its first ten minutes. Every player showed up in the first hour, and it left the world alone for the thirteen after that.
